title: WE PRAISE THEE, O GOD!
author: Wm P.Mackay
stanzas: We praise Thee, O God for the son of Thy love for Jesus who died and is now gone above
We praise Thee, O God for Thy spirit of light Who hath shown us our savior and scattered our night.
All glory and praise to the lamb that was slain who hath borne all our sins and hath cleansed every stain
All glory and praise to the God of all grace who hast brought us, and sought us, and guided our ways.
Revive us again Revive us again; Fill each heart with Thy love may each soul be rekindled with fire from above.
chorus: Hallelujah, thine the glory Hallelujah, amen Hallelujah, Thine the glory Revive us again
Hallelujah, thine the glory Hallelujah, amen Hallelujah, Thine the glory Revive us again
Hallelujah, thine the glory Hallelujah, amen Hallelujah, Thine the glory Revive us again
